name: go-static-embedded-binary
body: eypres must be written in Go and ship as a single self-contained static binary per supported target — Apple silicon macOS (darwin/arm64) and Windows x64 (windows/amd64), plus Windows ARM (windows/arm64) only when a GitHub-hosted native runner is available; never Intel macOS or Linux — with no external runtime or network dependency at run time; all assets must be embedded via Go embed.
